title: DocAtlas: Multilingual Document Understanding Across 80+ Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (via metrics like Text Edit Distance and TEDS) across a benchmark of 82 languages to compare accuracy between high-resource and low-resource languages, different language families, and diverse writing systems (e.g., underrepresented right-to-left scripts vs. English/Latin-centric scripts).

Comparing model extraction accuracy across various document layouts and types (e.g., academic literature and research reports vs. newspapers and magazines) to identify performance asymmetry resulting from training data composition.
